mentions.name: Ditto
mentions.description: Ditto is a website cloning tool that reproduces designs with 100% visual accuracy and outputs a proper React app with named components, clean component hierarchy, and preserved structure that can be extended as a starting point.
mentions.problem: When you find a design you love and want to use it as a starting point, the options are manually recreating it or using tools that output a tangled mess of divs and inline styles.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building Ditto — it clones websites with 100% visual accuracy and outputs a proper React app with named components and preserved structure.
